#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Point {
    int p, q, r, s, t;
    Point(int p, int q, int r, int s, int t) : p(p), q(q), r(r), s(s), t(t) {}
    Point minus(const Point& o) const {
        return Point(p - o.p, q - o.q, r - o.r, s - o.s, t - o.t);
    }
    double mag() const {
        return sqrt(1.0 * p * p + q * q + r * r + s * s + t * t);
    }
};

bool isAcute(const Point& a, const Point& b) {
    double dot = 1.0 * a.p * b.p + a.q * b.q + a.r * b.r + a.s * b.s + a.t * b.t;
    double ang = acos(dot / (a.mag() * b.mag())) * 180.0 / M_PI;
    return ang < 90;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    if (n > 11) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    vector<Point> points;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        int p, q, r, s, t;
        cin >> p >> q >> r >> s >> t;
        points.emplace_back(p, q, r, s, t);
    }
    set<int> good;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        bool isGood = true;
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
                if (i == j || i == k || j == k) continue;
                Point v1 = points[j].minus(points[i]);
                Point v2 = points[k].minus(points[i]);
                if (isAcute(v1, v2)) {
                    isGood = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!isGood) break;
        }
        if (isGood) good.insert(i + 1);
    }
    if (good.empty()) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
    } else {
        cout << good.size() << "\n";
        for (int idx : good) cout << idx << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
